ARC is a public Skills-first deployment architecture.

Before substantive work:
1. Read `AGENTS.md`.
2. For onboarding/deployment/diagnosis, use `.github/skills/atlas/SKILL.md`.
3. Default to plan mode; never mutate a target solely because credentials exist.
4. Never commit secret values or private business/client/personnel data.
5. Preserve one owner for each class of truth.
6. Prefer normal authorised tools/APIs before privileged runtime infrastructure.
7. Verify real state before claiming success.
